d:
Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge sparked a political controversy after describing Diwali as an “Eid of happiness” while extending festive greetings on November 7, 2026. The BJP accused him of appeasement and vote-bank politics, while Congress leaders defended his remarks, saying he was trying to convey a message of harmony and togetherness. AIMIM spokesperson Waris Pathan also questioned the comparison. What exactly did Kharge say, and why did his choice of words trigger criticism from different political parties?
Video Editor: Rahul
